title.narrative: STRATEGIC INITIATIVE FOR WOMEN IN THE HORN OF AFRI

description.narrative: Across Phases I–III, SIHA worked with Women Peace and Security Champions to build solidarity, strengthen feminist leadership, and create spaces for grassroots women to engage meaningfully in peace and policy processes. These phases laid the foundation for a growing movement of women activists who, despite operating in volatile and restrictive environments, continue to demand accountability, challenge exclusion, and ensure those women’s lived realities are centred in governance and peacebuilding. Phase IV builds directly on these achievements. It will expand protection and political influence for WPS Champions, strengthen feminist monitoring and accountability mechanisms, and scale community-level advocacy. By linking grassroots priorities to national, regional, and continental policy spaces, this phase seeks to consolidate the gains from earlier stages and embed sustained feminist leadership and accountability into peace and governance processes.
